contract.question: Summarize supplied single-instrument events in an independently specified UTC half-hour reporting horizon.
contract.inputs: Exact price/volume frame,1–10000 events,unique aware complete DatetimeIndex. Ordinary finite nonnegative numeric values. Aware Timestamp boundaries aligned to UTC half hours; positive horizon<=1day,all events inside[start,end). Consistent price and event-volume units assumed.
contract.outputs: UTC interval_end grid with at most48 right-labeled,left-closed,epoch-anchored bins. OHLC from chronologically sorted events,volume sum(min_count=1),event_count and has_observations. Leading/trailing empty bins preserved; financial measuresNaN,counts0.
contract.oracle: First[14:00,14:30) contains prices100,102,volume10+20=30,OHLC100/102/100/102. Boundary14:30 belongsnextbin close101. Counts[2,1,0,1],volumes30/5/NaN/7,sum42. Explicit end16:00 excluded. Single14:30event yields[0,1,0,0] with both edge gaps. Observedzero is distinct from emptyNaN.
contract.limits: Bins summarize supplied events,not certified complete feed or trading sessions. Bar label is neither close-observation time nor availability proof. Unique timestamps are a teaching grain,not general trade-feed grain. Cumulative volume cannot be summed as event volume; asfreq is grid selection,not OHLC. No venue calendar/multi-event ordering integration or exact accounting.

contract.question: Transform complete positive prices into adjacent-observation returns with explicit interval identities and endpoint reconciliation.
contract.inputs: Series2–10000 positive finite ordinary numeric prices,unique increasing aware index. Same instrument,currency,unit and adjustment basis,no flows/distributions/fees/FX. UTC-normalized copied numeric source; no implicit fill or inferred calendar.
contract.outputs: Price,interval_start,elapsed,simple_return,gross_return,log_return,cumulative_price_return. First intervalNaN/NaT with baseline cumulative0. Finite supported mature outputs,positive gross and simple>-1; zero prices excluded from combined log-capable API.
contract.oracle: 110/100-1=1/10;99/110-1=-1/10;grossproduct(11/10)*(9/10)-1=-1/100 equals99/100-1. Adjacent sum0 differsfromlinked-.01. Elapsed3days then1day. Logsum agreeswithmath.log(99/100) within1e-12. First cumulative0 is baseline,not an observed firstintervalreturn.
contract.limits: Rowpair is not daily/session interval. No-fill does not prove expected schedule completeness. Positive-price returns do not establish total-return adjustment/corporate-action/cashflow correctness. Normal rounding and small-change/log cancellation remain; strict range guards are not arbitrary precision. Terminalzero could support a separate simple-only contract,not this combined API.
